decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the firm’s established marking portfolio, the workstation still has option value and likely low enough carrying cost to remain on the market while demand across applications becomes clearer.

This thermal inkjet printer is very close to the firm’s core offer and strategic direction, so a growing, well-resourced firm would typically keep it in place rather than abandon it after only one year.
The piezo inkjet printer fits the existing technology base and customer needs, and with uncertainty still unresolved the firm is more likely to preserve this option than to exit it quickly.
